value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says “Get into the locked room. Pick up the ball.” which is an ordered command of two steps. According to the guidelines this requires a hard Existence for the last step (target_picked_up) and a hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up). The candidate provides hard Existence for both target_room_entered and target_picked_up but lacks the Precedence clause, so the required order is not enforced. Moreover, once the correct Precedence clause is added, the hard Existence(target_room_entered) becomes redundant (the Precedence+Existence of the last step already forces entering the room). Fix: replace the two hard Existence clauses with a hard Existence(target_picked_up) and a hard Precedence(target_room_entered, target_picked_up); remove the redundant Existence(target_room_entered).
